run_local_evaluation: run local evaluation on LCM tasks using a CliConfig and log results
run_task_with_config: run an evaluation task with a parsed run config and distributed gang
parse_cli_configs: parse a CliConfig into a list of run configs from task patterns
write_results_to_json: write flattened metric results and configs to a JSON file
log_final_results: log final aggregated evaluation results to tensorboard and metric directories
